title: DyPES-VLA: Learning Shared Dynamics Priors and Embodiment-Specific Control for Cross-Embodiment Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a powerful paradigm for robot manipulation, but training a single generalist policy for heterogeneous robot embodiments remains an open problem. Existing methods have two main limitations. First, they underuse dynamics priors shared across diverse visual and interaction data, limiting cross-embodiment transfer. Second, they require extensive manual preprocessing to convert embodiment-specific actions into a common format. To overcome these limitations, we propose DyPES-VLA, a cross-embodiment VLA that learns shared Dynamics Priors and Embodiment-Specific control. First, we learn shared dynamics priors by training the vision-language model (VLM) with a future-prediction objective on cross-embodiment data, driving the shared query representation to capture object motion, contact, and interaction-induced scene changes. Second, an embodiment-specific Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) action head translates these shared dynamics priors into executable controls directly in each embodiment's native action space, without manually pre-aligning heterogeneous actions into a common format. This head shares attention layers to capture common temporal action structures, while its embodiment-specific feed-forward experts resolve the unique kinematic constraints and control semantics of distinct embodiments. As a generalist policy, our \ourmethod achieves state-of-the-art performance across simulation and real-world evaluations, reaching 98.0% success on LIBERO, 59.25% on RoboCasa-GR1, and 89.02% on RoboTwin~2.0.
tldr: DyPES-VLA learns shared dynamics priors via future-prediction pretraining of a VLM and uses an embodiment-specific Mixture-of-Experts action head to handle heterogeneous robot action spaces without manual alignment, achieving state-of-the-art cross-embodiment manipulation.
tldr_zh: DyPES-VLA通过未来预测预训练视觉语言模型学习共享动力学先验，并采用具身特定的混合专家动作头处理异构机器人动作空间，无需手动对齐，在跨具身操作任务中达到最先进性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为机器人操作领域的一种强大范式，但针对异构机器人本体训练单一通用策略仍是一个悬而未决的问题。现有方法存在两个主要局限：首先，它们未能充分利用跨多种视觉与交互数据中共有的动力学先验知识，限制了跨本体的迁移能力；其次，它们需要大量人工预处理来将特定本体的动作转换为统一格式。为克服这些局限，我们提出了DyPES-VLA——一种学习共享动力学先验与本体特定控制的跨本体VLA模型。首先，我们通过跨本体数据上的未来预测目标训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）来学习共享动力学先验，促使共享查询表征捕获物体运动、接触及交互引发的场景变化。其次，一个由本体特定混合专家（MoE）组成的动作头直接将共享动力学先验转换为各本体原生动作空间中的可执行控制指令，无需手动将异构动作预对齐至统一格式。该动作头通过共享注意力层捕获共性的时间动作结构，同时其本体特定的前馈专家模块解析不同本体的独特运动学约束与控制语义。作为通用策略，我们的模型在仿真与现实评估中均取得最优性能：在LIBERO上达到98.0%的成功率，在RoboCasa-GR1上达到59.25%，在RoboTwin 2.0上达到89.02%。

title: Beyond Flat Policies: Hierarchical Post-Training for Embodied Agents in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in robotic manipulation by leveraging pretrained vision-language models. However, existing post-training methods predominantly optimize VLA models as flat policies, making it difficult to explicitly model task progression and perform robust long-horizon manipulation. Although hierarchical approaches introduce task decomposition, they mainly rely on supervised learning from offline demonstrations and cannot effectively improve execution through online interaction. To address this limitation, we propose Hierarchical Robotic Control (HiRoC), a hierarchical post-training framework that decouples high-level task planning from low-level action execution. The planner decomposes complex tasks into executable subgoals to provide explicit semantic guidance, while the executor continuously improves subgoal-conditioned action generation through reinforcement learning. To enable effective collaboration between the two modules, we further align the executor with planner-generated subgoals before reinforcement learning, mitigating the distribution misalignment between planning and execution. Extensive experiments across diverse robotic manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that HiRoC consistently outperforms strong baselines. Comprehensive analyses further validate the effectiveness of hierarchical post-training and the contribution of each key component.
tldr: HiRoC is a hierarchical post-training framework that decouples high-level task planning from low-level action execution for VLA models, using RL to improve long-horizon manipulation and addressing distribution misalignment between planning and execution.
tldr_zh: HiRoC是一种分层后训练框架，将高层任务规划与低层动作执行解耦，通过强化学习改善长程操作，并解决规划与执行之间的分布不匹配问题。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过利用预训练的视觉-语言模型，在机器人操作中展现出了卓越的能力。然而，现有的后训练方法主要将VLA模型优化为扁平化策略，导致难以显式建模任务进程并实现稳健的长时域操作。尽管层次化方法引入了任务分解，但其主要依赖离线示范数据的监督学习，无法通过在线交互有效提升执行性能。为解决这一局限，我们提出层次化机器人控制（HiRoC）框架——一种将高层级任务规划与低层级动作执行解耦的层次化后训练框架。规划器将复杂任务分解为可执行的子目标以提供显式语义引导，而执行器则通过强化学习持续改进基于子目标的动作生成。为使两个模块高效协作，我们进一步在强化学习前将执行器与规划器生成的子目标进行对齐，缓解规划与执行之间的分布不匹配问题。在多种机器人操作基准上的广泛实验表明，HiRoC始终优于强基线方法。综合分析进一步验证了层次化后训练的有效性及各关键组件的贡献。

title: XEWorld: Can Action-Conditioned World Models Generalize to Unseen Robot Embodiments?
summary: Action-conditioned world models are promising learned simulators for robotic manipulation, yet evaluating them exclusively on training robots fails to reveal whether they capture physical dynamics or merely memorize visual patterns. To answer whether a model can faithfully render a robot it has never seen, we introduce XEWorld, a controlled cross-embodiment testbed for world models that isolates embodiments by evaluating held-out robots within physically identical scenes. Our systematic analysis uncovers a shared architectural bottleneck: current models act primarily as 2D visual pattern matchers whose generalization is governed by visual similarity rather than physical kinematic similarity. Driven by this limitation, they struggle to translate abstract numeric joint actions into coherent visual trajectories, and fail to predict dynamic visual changes from static initial observations. Consequently, successfully rendering an unseen embodiment zero-shot strictly requires heavily grounded cues, specifically pixel-space actions and explicit spatial-temporal alignment. Even when bypassing this zero-shot barrier via few-shot adaptation, the forced appearance recovery triggers catastrophic forgetting of seen embodiments. Together, these failures expose a critical inability to apply learned physical dynamics to novel visual appearances, highlighting that achieving true cross-embodiment generalization requires architectural innovations that decouple visual appearance from underlying physical dynamics.
tldr: XEWorld introduces a cross-embodiment testbed to evaluate action-conditioned world models, revealing that current models act as 2D visual pattern matchers limited by visual similarity and fail to generalize to unseen robot embodiments without strong visual grounding cues or few-shot adaptation.
tldr_zh: XEWorld提出了一个跨实体测试平台，用于评估动作条件世界模型，揭示了当前模型本质上作为2D视觉模式匹配器，受视觉相似性限制，并且在没有强视觉线索或小样本适应的情况下无法泛化到未见过的机器人实体。
summary_zh: 动作条件世界模型是面向机器人操作的有前景的学习型模拟器，然而仅在训练用机器人上评估这些模型，无法揭示其究竟是捕捉了物理动力学，还是仅仅记忆了视觉模式。为了判断模型能否忠实渲染其从未见过的机器人，我们提出了XEWorld——一个受控的跨实体世界模型测试平台，通过在物理相同的场景中评估留出实体来隔离不同实体。我们的系统分析揭示了一个共同的架构瓶颈：当前模型主要充当2D视觉模式匹配器，其泛化能力由视觉相似性而非物理运动学相似性主导。受此局限，它们难以将抽象的数值化关节动作转化为连贯的视觉轨迹，也无法从静态初始观测中预测动态视觉变化。因此，零样本成功渲染未见实体严格依赖于高度具象化的线索——具体而言是像素空间动作和显式的时空对齐。即使通过少样本适应绕开这一零样本障碍，强制的外观恢复也会引发已见实体的灾难性遗忘。综上所述，这些失败暴露了模型在将学习到的物理动力学应用于新视觉外观时的关键能力缺失，凸显实现真正跨实体泛化需要能够分离视觉外观与底层物理动力学的架构创新。

title: In-Context VLA: Endowing Vision-Language-Action Models with Language via In-Context Post-Training and Agentic Tool Use
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become the dominant recipe for generalist manipulation, yet they are almost universally trained by behavior cloning: a policy imitates expert action chunks conditioned on a static image and a fixed instruction. A natural remedy is to inject explicit reasoning through textual chain-of-thought (CoT). We show, both empirically and analytically, that free-form textual CoT degrades low-level control: the reasoning it produces is ungrounded, its latency breaks closed-loop timing, and, crucially, the reasoning and action tokens are optimized against conflicting objectives so that the policy learns to narrate rather than to act. We argue that what a VLA needs is not the ability to generate language, but the ability to consume grounded language. To this end we introduce \textbf{\ourmethod{}}, a framework that endows a VLA with language competence through (i) in-context post-training, in which perceptual evidence is injected as structured context and the model is supervised only on actions, and (ii) an agentic tool-use interface, in which the policy queries open-vocabulary detectors, monocular depth, and a vision--language model to actively acquire task-relevant information. Rather than emitting a single templated caption, our data engine produces diverse, paraphrased, and evidence-conditioned spatial descriptions, so that the policy learns to interpret language it has never seen verbatim. Across the RoboCasa-GR1, SimplerEnv, and LIBERO simulation benchmarks, together with 8 real-world robot manipulation tasks, our method consistently achieves SOTA results in both performance and efficiency when compared with CoT-based approaches under matched configurations.
tldr: This paper proposes In-Context VLA, a framework that improves Vision-Language-Action models for robotic manipulation by using in-context post-training with structured perceptual evidence and agentic tool use, avoiding the performance degradation caused by free-form chain-of-thought reasoning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出In-Context VLA框架，通过结构化感知上下文的上下文后训练和代理工具使用来改进视觉-语言-动作模型的机器人操作性能，避免了自由形式思维链推理导致的性能下降。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为通用操控任务的主流范式，但这些模型几乎普遍采用行为克隆进行训练：策略基于静态图像和固定指令，模仿专家动作片段。一种自然的改进方案是通过文本思维链（CoT）注入显式推理。我们通过实验与理论分析证明，自由形式的文本CoT会削弱底层控制能力：其产生的推理缺乏依据，延迟破坏闭环时序，且关键问题在于——推理与动作token的优化目标相互冲突，导致策略学会叙述而非执行。我们认为VLA所需的并非生成语言的能力，而是理解具身语言的能力。为此，我们提出\textbf{\ourmethod{}}框架，通过以下方式赋予VLA语言能力：（i）上下文后训练——将感知证据作为结构化上下文注入，模型仅受动作监督；（ii）智能体工具调用接口——策略通过查询开放词汇检测器、单目深度与视觉语言模型主动获取任务相关信息。与生成单一模板化描述不同，我们的数据引擎产生多样化、复述化且基于证据的空间描述，使策略能理解从未逐字见过的语言。在RoboCasa-GR1、SimplerEnv、LIBERO模拟基准测试以及8项真实机器人操控任务中，与同等配置下基于CoT的方法相比，本方法在性能与效率上均持续达到最优结果。

title: JoyAI-RA 0.5: Scaling Robot Manipulation Learning via Dual Action Alignment
summary: Robot data is scarce, so generalist policies need to learn from heterogeneous sources, including human egocentric video, simulation, and real robots, which differ in supervision and embodiment, with action labels missing or mutually incompatible. Human egocentric data scale best but sit farthest from robot data, and naive pooling causes negative transfer rather than knowledge sharing. We propose JoyAI-RA 0.5, a generalist Vision-Language-World-Action (VLWA) framework that couples physical world-dynamics priors with visual semantics and scales manipulation learning across such data via dual action alignment. Implicit action alignment infers latent actions from visual transitions, enabling action-free human, simulation, and robot data to guide a latent-action-conditioned world model in learning physical dynamics. Explicit alignment grounds reliable human and robot trajectories in a unified physical action space through a canonical action representation and camera-frame chunk-relative end-effector actions. An inner-outer-loop reinforcement stage then pairs efficient task adaptation with foundation-policy improvement. On a real-world AgiBot benchmark, JoyAI-RA performs strongly on both seen tasks and unseen variations. The task score improves consistently as the volume of human egocentric pretraining data increases and shows no sign of plateauing at our largest scale. This suggests that abundant but weakly labeled human experience can be converted into a transferable training signal, making human video not merely a weak auxiliary source but a primary axis along which manipulation capability can be scaled. Project page can be found at https://joyai-ra-05.github.io/.
tldr: JoyAI-RA 0.5 introduces a Vision-Language-World-Action (VLWA) framework with dual action alignment to scale robot manipulation learning by leveraging heterogeneous data sources including human egocentric video, simulation, and real robot data.
tldr_zh: JoyAI-RA 0.5提出了一种视觉-语言-世界-动作（VLWA）框架，通过双重动作对齐，利用包括人类自我中心视频、仿真和真实机器人数据在内的异构数据源来扩展机器人操作学习。
summary_zh: 机器人数据稀缺，因此通用策略需要从异构源中学习，包括人类第一人称视频、仿真环境和真实机器人——这些数据在监督信号和具身形态上存在差异，且动作标签要么缺失、要么互不兼容。人类第一人称数据规模最大，但与机器人数据的距离最远，而简单混合会导致负迁移而非知识共享。我们提出JoyAI-RA 0.5，一个通用的视觉-语言-世界-动作（VLWA）框架，它将物理世界动力学先验与视觉语义相结合，并通过双重动作对齐跨此类数据扩展操作学习。隐式动作对齐从视觉变化中推断潜在动作，使无动作标签的人类、仿真和机器人数据能够引导基于潜在动作的世界模型学习物理动力学。显式动作对齐通过规范动作表示和基于相机帧的相对末端执行器动作，将可靠的人类与机器人轨迹统一至物理动作空间。随后，内外双环强化阶段将高效任务适应与基础策略改进相结合。在真实世界AgiBot基准测试中，JoyAI-RA在已知任务与未见变体上均表现强劲。随着人类第一人称预训练数据规模的扩大，任务分数持续提升，且在我们最大规模数据上仍未呈现饱和趋势。这表明，大量但弱标注的人类经验可转化为可迁移的训练信号，使人类视频不仅成为弱辅助源，更成为操作能力扩展的核心主轴。项目页面详见https://joyai-ra-05.github.io/。

title: World-to-Wrist: Task-Conditioned Future Wrist Modeling for Fine-Grained Robot Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often treat main-view and wrist-view observations as parallel visual inputs, overlooking their distinct roles in robot manipulation. Fine-grained manipulation, however, benefits from anticipating how wrist-local interactions may evolve under the global task context. To address this limitation, we present World-to-Wrist VLA (W2-VLA), a VLA model for fine-grained robot manipulation with task-conditioned future wrist modeling. Given current multi-view observations and a task instruction, W2-VLA contextualizes a set of latent modeling tokens as a compact interface between the vision-language model and the wrist predictor. Conditioned on this interface and the observed wrist history, the predictor forecasts future wrist latents, which are transformed into future-aware context for action prediction. In addition, we introduce W2-CoT, a synthesis pipeline that produces structured annotations describing manipulation progress, physical transition cues, and wrist-local evidence. These annotations provide auxiliary supervision that shapes the task-conditioned latent interface. Experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improved fine-grained and contact-sensitive manipulation across both single-arm and bimanual settings, while maintaining action-generation rates above 80 Hz.
tldr: W2-VLA introduces task-conditioned future wrist modeling and structured CoT annotations to improve fine-grained, contact-sensitive manipulation in both single-arm and bimanual settings.
tldr_zh: W2-VLA 通过任务条件化的未来手腕建模和结构化思维链标注，提升了单臂和双臂场景中的精细及接触敏感操作能力。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型常将主视角与腕部视角观测视为并行的视觉输入，忽略了它们在机器人操作中的不同作用。然而，精细操作得益于在全局任务背景下预判腕部局部交互如何演变。为解决这一局限，我们提出World-to-Wrist VLA（W2-VLA）——一种面向精细机器人操作、具备任务条件未来腕部建模能力的VLA模型。给定当前多视角观测与任务指令后，W2-VLA将一组潜在建模令牌作为视觉-语言模型与腕部预测器之间的紧凑接口进行上下文化。基于该接口与已观测腕部历史，预测器可推断未来腕部潜在特征，并将其转化为未来感知上下文以指导动作预测。此外，我们引入W2-CoT综合管线，该管线可生成描述操作进度、物理过渡线索及腕部局部证据的结构化注释。这些注释提供的辅助监督信号塑造了任务条件化潜在接口。在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0及真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，该方法在单臂与双臂场景中均显著提升了精细操作与接触敏感操作性能，同时保持80Hz以上的动作生成速率。

title: $ω$-0: A Latent Predictive World Action Model for Concurrent Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Humanoid household tasks often require concurrent loco-manipulation, where the robot must move, adjust posture, maintain balance, and manipulate objects as a single coordinated behavior. Yet existing humanoid policies typically decompose locomotion and manipulation, while recent world-action models remain either arm-centric or video-centered. We present $ω$-0, a latent predictive whole-body world-action model for real-world humanoid concurrent loco-manipulation. Given a language instruction, current visual observation, and robot proprioceptive state, $ω$-0 directly predicts controller-compatible whole-body action latents for real-robot execution. Rather than reconstructing future videos, $ω$-0 learns compact future observation embeddings as a lightweight predictive objective, coupling latent visual foresight with diffusion-based whole-body action generation. The model supports egocentric RGB, exocentric RGB, and exocentric depth inputs, and leverages controller-based simulation replay to ground human/public visual-motion priors into robot-executable action latents. We further collect $ω$-HOME, a 40+ hour real-world household humanoid dataset with synchronized multi-view observations, whole-body SMPL motions, robot states, and action latents. Real-world experiments on 11 household tasks demonstrate that a single $ω$-0 model can produce smooth manipulate-while-moving behaviors and consistently outperform representative imitation learning, VLA, humanoid, and WAM baselines.
tldr: ω-0 is a latent predictive whole-body world-action model for real-world humanoid concurrent loco-manipulation, directly predicting controller-compatible whole-body action latents from language, vision, and proprioception without future video reconstruction.
tldr_zh: ω-0 是一个用于真实世界人形机器人同步移动操作的潜在预测全身世界行动模型，直接从语言、视觉和本体感觉预测控制器兼容的全身行动潜在变量，无需重建未来视频。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
类人家庭任务通常需要同时进行全身协调的操作与移动，即机器人必须将移动、姿态调整、平衡维持与物体操作整合为单一协调行为。然而，现有的人形机器人策略通常将移动与操作分解处理，而近期的世界-动作模型要么以手臂为中心，要么以视频为中心。我们提出$ω$-0——一种面向真实世界人形机器人同步移动-操作任务的潜在预测型全身世界-动作模型。给定语言指令、当前视觉观测与机器人本体感知状态，$ω$-0可直接预测与控制器兼容的全身动作潜在表征，用于真实机器人执行。不同于重建未来视频，$ω$-0将紧凑的未来观测嵌入作为轻量级预测目标进行学习，从而将潜在视觉前瞻与基于扩散的全身动作生成相结合。该模型支持第一人称RGB、第三人称RGB及第三人称深度输入，并利用基于控制器的仿真回放技术，将人类/公共视觉-运动先验知识映射为机器人可执行的潜在动作表征。我们进一步收集了$ω$-HOME数据集——包含40余小时的真实世界家庭场景人形机器人数据，同步采集了多视角观测、全身SMPL运动、机器人状态及动作潜在表征。在11项家庭任务的真实世界实验中表明，单一$ω$-0模型即可生成流畅的“边移动边操作”行为，并持续优于具有代表性的模仿学习、VLA、人形机器人及WAM基线方法。

title: GeniWorld: A Generalizable Interactive World Model for Robotic Manipulation via Visual Actions
summary: Generalist robot policies exhibit strong capabilities, but their robustness in complex and unseen environments remains limited. Scaling robot learning and evaluation in diverse real-world environments remains costly and challenging. Action-conditioned world models offer a promising alternative, but they often suffer from limited action controllability and poor generalization to out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. To this end, we present GeniWorld, an interactive world model for robots that generalizes robustly across unseen scenarios. Building on pretrained video generative models, we use URDF-based rendering to transform numerical actions into visual action representations, enabling spatially grounded action control. By explicitly decoupling embodiment kinematics from environmental dynamics, our model mitigates scene overfitting and facilitates modeling of robot-environment interactions. To achieve closed-loop control, we construct an autoregressive video prediction model integrated with high-frequency robot kinematic control, enabling interaction with both robot policies and human teleoperators. In our experiments, even when trained solely on limited fixed-scene data, our model achieves superior in-domain performance and robust zero-shot generalization to highly randomized, unseen environments. For downstream applications, GeniWorld serves as a scalable policy evaluator that remains reliable under environmental perturbations. Furthermore, even with limited real-world demonstrations, GeniWorld generates diverse manipulation trajectories within the world model, improving downstream policy performance and robustness in complex environments.
tldr: GeniWorld introduces an interactive world model for robotic manipulation that uses URDF-based visual action representations to enable spatially grounded control and robust zero-shot generalization to unseen environments, serving as a scalable policy evaluator and trajectory generator.
tldr_zh: GeniWorld 提出了一种用于机器人操作的交互式世界模型，通过基于 URDF 的视觉动作表示实现空间接地控制，并在未见环境中展现出鲁棒的零样本泛化能力，可作为可扩展的策略评估器和轨迹生成器。
summary_zh: 通用型机器人策略展现出强大的能力，但在复杂及未见环境中的鲁棒性仍较为有限。在多样化的真实环境中规模化扩展机器人学习与评估依然成本高昂且充满挑战。基于动作的条件世界模型作为一种有前景的替代方案，却常面临动作可控性不足及对分布外场景泛化能力差的困境。为此，我们提出GeniWorld——一种能跨未见场景实现鲁棒泛化的机器人交互式世界模型。基于预训练的视频生成模型，我们利用URDF渲染技术将数值型动作转换为视觉化动作表征，从而实现空间锚定的动作控制。通过将具身运动学与环境动力学显式解耦，该模型缓解了场景过拟合问题，并促进了机器人-环境交互的建模。为实现闭环控制，我们构建了与高频机器人运动控制相集成的自回归视频预测模型，使其既能与机器人策略交互，也能支持人类遥操作。在实验中，即使仅在有限的固定场景数据上训练，该模型仍能在域内场景中取得优异性能，并对高度随机化的未见环境实现鲁棒的零样本泛化。在下游应用中，GeniWorld可作为可扩展的策略评估器，在环境扰动下保持可靠性。此外，即使仅有少量真实世界演示数据，GeniWorld仍能在世界模型内生成多样化的操作轨迹，从而提升下游策略在复杂环境中的性能与鲁棒性。

title: VIDP: Variable Impedance Diffusion Policy for Compliant Robot Manipulation from Diverse Demonstrations
summary: Contact-rich manipulation requires precise tracking and mechanical compliance, where variable impedance control can improve robustness in task success, whereas static compliance cannot adapt to varying contact constraints. Variable impedance skills can be learned from demonstrations, avoiding complex modeling, but compliance is a hidden variable in force-agnostic kinematic data. While existing methods infer compliance from trajectory variations, these variations may reflect geometric adaptation and not intentional compliance when subject to changing spatial layouts. Therefore, this letter introduces Variable Impedance Diffusion Policy (VIDP), an imitation learning-based variable impedance control framework leveraging a Task-Parameterized Directionality-Aware Mixture Model (TP-DAMM) to extract physically consistent trajectory distributions from diverse demonstrations. By mapping distributions to stiffness profiles, VIDP jointly predicts pose actions and task compliance without force sensors. Real-world experiments show that VIDP significantly outperforms fixed-impedance baselines in task success rate while reducing interaction forces with respect to high stiffness controllers and tracking errors with respect to low stiffness baselines.
tldr: VIDP proposes an imitation learning framework that extracts physically consistent trajectory distributions from diverse demonstrations to predict both pose actions and variable impedance profiles, enabling compliant robot manipulation without force sensors.
tldr_zh: VIDP 提出了一种从多样化演示中提取物理一致轨迹分布的模仿学习框架，用于同时预测位姿动作和可变阻抗配置，实现了无需力传感器的柔顺机器人操作。
summary_zh: 接触丰富的操作任务需要精确跟踪与机械柔顺性，其中可变阻抗控制能提升任务成功的鲁棒性，而静态阻抗则无法适应变化的接触约束。可变阻抗技能可通过示教学习（避免复杂建模），但柔顺性作为变量隐藏于不包含力信息的运动学数据中。现有方法虽能从轨迹变化推断柔顺性，但这些变化可能源于空间布局改变时的几何适应，而非意图性柔顺。为此，本文提出可变阻抗扩散策略（VIDP），一种基于模仿学习的可变阻抗控制框架，通过任务参数化方向感知混合模型（TP-DAMM）从多源示教中提取物理一致的轨迹分布。将分布映射为刚度分布后，VIDP无需力传感器即可联合预测位姿动作与任务柔顺性。真实世界实验表明，VIDP在任务成功率上显著优于固定阻抗基线方法，同时相较于高刚度控制器降低了交互力，相较于低刚度基线方法减少了跟踪误差。

title: Adaptive-WAM: Quality-Guided Early-Exit Planning from Intermediate Video-Diffusion Features
summary: Large video diffusion models provide rich spatiotemporal priors for autonomous driving, but existing world-action models often inherit the cost of iterative future-video generation even though deployment only requires an ego trajectory. We ask a more basic question: how much of a video diffusion model must be executed to make a reliable driving decision? Through a controlled study of video denoising timesteps and Diffusion Transformer (DiT) depth, we find that planning performance is largely insensitive to the tested video-noise levels, whereas strong trajectories can already be decoded from intermediate layers. Based on this observation, we introduce Adaptive-WAM, a quality-aware multi-exit planner built on a Wan2.2-5B backbone. Trajectory diffusion heads are attached to selected DiT blocks, and a lightweight trajectory-quality scorer terminates inference once the best trajectory decoded so far satisfies a quality threshold; otherwise, computation continues from the cached hidden state to a deeper exit. The deployed planner therefore avoids the iterative classifier-free denoising loop and VAE decoding required for future-video synthesis, while dynamically allocating backbone depth according to trajectory quality. On NAVSIM, the adaptive single-trajectory planner achieves 90.8 PDMS; a separate fixed-exit variant reaches 92.6 PDMS with 64 proposals. It further obtains 89.9 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, yielding the best reported results among the compared front-view video world-model planners. Without target-domain fine-tuning, Adaptive-WAM transfers to nuScenes with 0.88 m average L2 error and a 0.08\% collision rate. On an A100, adaptive routing improves PDMS from 90.62 to 90.79 while averaging 170 ms end-to-end planning latency, approximately 10\% below the 190 ms fixed block-15 planner and 47\% below the 320 ms fixed full-depth planner. Code will be released.
tldr: Adaptive-WAM introduces a quality-guided multi-exit planner that skips full video diffusion generation by decoding trajectories from intermediate DiT layers, achieving real-time driving planning with competitive accuracy.
tldr_zh: Adaptive-WAM 提出了一种质量引导的多出口规划器，通过从中间 DiT 层解码轨迹来跳过完整的视频扩散生成，从而实现实时驾驶规划并保持竞争性精度。
summary_zh: 大型视频扩散模型为自动驾驶提供了丰富的时空先验知识，但现有的世界-动作模型往往继承了迭代式未来视频生成的计算代价，尽管部署时仅需自车轨迹。我们提出一个更基础的问题：为做出可靠的驾驶决策，视频扩散模型必须执行到何种程度？通过对视频去噪时间步长和扩散Transformer（DiT）深度进行受控研究，我们发现规划性能对测试的视频噪声水平基本不敏感，而强轨迹已可从中间层解码。基于此观察，我们提出Adaptive-WAM，一种基于Wan2.2-5B主干网络构建的质量感知多出口规划器。轨迹扩散头被附加到选定的DiT模块上，轻量级轨迹质量评分器在当前解码的最佳轨迹满足质量阈值时终止推理；否则，计算将从缓存的隐藏状态继续到更深层的出口。因此，部署后的规划器避免了未来视频合成所需的迭代式无分类器去噪循环和VAE解码，同时根据轨迹质量动态分配主干网络深度。在NAVSIM上，自适应单轨迹规划器达到90.8 PDMS；独立的固定出口变体通过64个提议达到92.6 PDMS。该规划器在NAVSIM v2上进一步获得89.9 EPDMS，在对比的前视图视频世界模型规划器中取得了最佳报告结果。无需目标域微调，Adaptive-WAM迁移至nuScenes时平均L2误差为0.88米，碰撞率为0.08%。在A100上，自适应路由将PDMS从90.62提升至90.79，同时平均端到端规划延迟为170毫秒，比固定block-15规划器的190毫秒低约10%，比固定全深度规划器的320毫秒低47%。代码将开源。

title: TRACE: Learned Proprioceptive Odometry for Legged Robots under Unreliable Contact Conditions
summary: In this paper, we present TRACE (Tokenized Robust Attention for Contact-Aware Estimation), an end-to-end learned proprioceptive odometry estimator for legged robots under unreliable contact conditions. The proposed estimator directly predicts relative displacement, relative rotation, and body-frame velocity from a recent history of onboard inertial and joint measurements. To improve robustness under unreliable contact conditions, we introduce a foot-aware cross-attention module that adaptively weights IMU and leg-wise kinematic tokens without relying on manually defined contact or slip thresholds. The estimator is trained with direct supervision and two physics-inspired auxiliary losses that promote kinematic consistency and reliable use of leg information. To reduce policy-specific overfitting and consequently improve sim-to-real transfer, simulation training incorporates policy randomization, followed by partial real-world fine-tuning of the temporal encoder and prediction head. Experiments across diverse indoor and outdoor terrains demonstrate consistent reductions in position drift compared with classical filtering-based, hybrid, and purely learning-based baselines. Ablation studies further validate the contributions of the proposed training objectives, policy randomization, and real-world fine-tuning, particularly under unreliable contacts and sim-to-real mismatch.
tldr: TRACE is an end-to-end learned proprioceptive odometry estimator for legged robots that uses a foot-aware cross-attention module and physics-inspired auxiliary losses to achieve robust state estimation under unreliable contact conditions.
tldr_zh: TRACE是一种针对足式机器人的端到端学习的本体感觉里程计估计器，通过足部感知交叉注意力模块和物理启发的辅助损失，在不可靠接触条件下实现鲁棒的位姿估计。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为TRACE（基于标记化稳健注意力的接触感知估计器）的端到端学习型本体感受里程计估计器，专用于在不可靠接触条件下运行的足式机器人。该估计器可直接根据机载惯性传感器与关节测量的近期历史数据，预测相对位移、相对旋转及机体坐标系速度。为提升不可靠接触条件下的鲁棒性，我们引入了一种足部感知交叉注意力模块，该模块无需依赖人工定义的接触或滑移阈值，即可自适应地对IMU与腿部运动学标记进行加权。估计器训练采用直接监督学习与两种基于物理原理的辅助损失函数，以增强运动学一致性并确保腿部信息的可靠利用。为减少策略特定过拟合进而改善仿真到现实的迁移效果，仿真训练中结合了策略随机化，随后对时序编码器与预测头进行部分真实世界微调。在多种室内外地形上的实验表明，与经典滤波方法、混合方法及纯学习方法相比，本方法在位置漂移方面均实现了一致性降低。消融研究进一步验证了所提训练目标、策略随机化及真实世界微调的有效性，尤其在不可靠接触与仿真现实差异场景下表现突出。

title: SkillMemo: Expert-guided Skill Memory Framework for Compositional Embodied Manipulation
summary: Embodied visuomotor models, including Diffusion Policy (DP) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, have demonstrated promising performance on robotic manipulation benchmarks. However, their potential remains fundamentally constrained by the scarcity of large-scale embodied trajectory datasets, leading to insufficient compositional generalization in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios with limited capability to capture reusable skill structures. To address this limitation, we propose Skill-Based Memory (SkillMemo) framework that implicitly decomposes long-horizon demonstrations into latent atomic skills and integrates skill-level features into a dynamic episodic memory bank for solving compositional tasks. Specifically, we first introduce an expert-guided trajectory segmentation module built upon a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, which implicitly partitions trajectories into distinct skill primitives represented by learned gating coefficients. We further design a skill-level episodic memory architecture that stores compact skill representations as retrievable key-value pairs. During inference, the memory bank retrieves the most relevant skill primitives which are subsequently fused with the model's current gating distribution, providing a robust contextual prior to refine action predictions. Extensive experiments on the simulation benchmark and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that SkillMemo consistently enhances both DP and VLA backbones, achieving state-of-the-art performance and outperforming $π_{0.5}$, while exhibiting strong compositional generalization to unseen task configurations.
tldr: SkillMemo introduces an expert-guided skill decomposition and episodic memory framework that enhances VLA and diffusion-based policies for compositional manipulation, achieving state-of-the-art results on simulated and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: SkillMemo 提出了一种专家引导的技能分解与情景记忆框架，增强了 VLA 和扩散策略在组合操作任务上的表现，在仿真和真实场景中达到最优性能。
summary_zh: 具身视觉运动模型，包括扩散策略（DP）和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，已在机器人操作基准测试中展现出良好的性能。然而，其潜力从根本上受限于大规模具身轨迹数据集的稀缺性，导致在分布外（OOD）场景中组合泛化能力不足，且难以捕捉可复用的技能结构。为解决这一局限，我们提出基于技能的记忆（SkillMemo）框架，该框架隐式地将长程演示分解为潜在原子技能，并将技能级特征整合到动态情节记忆库中，以解决组合任务。具体而言，我们首先引入一个基于专家混合（MoE）架构的专家引导轨迹分割模块，该模块隐式地将轨迹划分为由学习到的门控系数表示的不同技能基元。我们进一步设计了一种技能级情节记忆架构，将紧凑的技能表示存储为可检索的键值对。在推理阶段，记忆库检索出最相关的技能基元，并将其与模型当前的门控分布融合，从而提供鲁棒的上下文先验以优化动作预测。在仿真基准和真实世界操作任务上的大量实验表明，SkillMemo能够持续增强DP和VLA骨干网络，实现最先进的性能并超越$π_{0.5}$，同时在未见过的任务配置中展现出强大的组合泛化能力。

title: GAUGE: A Measurement-Grounded Benchmark for Physical Fidelity in Simulation Engines and Video World Models
summary: Physics engines facilitate large-scale training and evaluation for embodied intelligence, while generative video world models are emerging as implicit simulators of future states and interactions. However, existing evaluations of physical fidelity are often conducted in isolation and rely heavily on perceptual similarity or human judgments, providing limited insight into which physical principles or parameters are violated. We introduce GAUGE, a real-world-grounded diagnostic benchmark for jointly evaluating how numerical simulators and generative video world models reproduce or deviate from real-world physics. It comprises 22 controlled task families covering rigid bodies, flexible cables, textiles, and volumetric deformable objects. Grounded in real-world trajectories and paired with calibrated physical metadata, uncertainty annotations, and task-specific observables, these tasks cover fundamental physical processes including collision, friction, momentum transfer, oscillation, self-contact, and deformation across diverse materials and conditions. We benchmark Isaac Sim, Genesis, and Newton on 14 task families using generalized trajectory errors, and evaluate 6 image-to-video models on 5 rigid-body tasks by testing physical-law consistency and the temporal stability of inferred parameters. Our results reveal no uniformly faithful physics engine, with the largest discrepancies arising in impulsive contact, rapid textile motion, and volumetric deformation. We further find that video world models can produce trajectories with the expected equation form while recovering incorrect accelerations, momentum transfer, and oscillation timing. GAUGE lays the groundwork for developing more physically faithful simulators and world models for embodied intelligence.
tldr: GAUGE is a benchmark with real-world grounding that jointly evaluates the physical fidelity of simulation engines and video world models across 22 controlled task families, revealing systematic errors in both types of simulators.
tldr_zh: GAUGE是一个基于真实世界数据的基准，用于联合评估物理仿真引擎和视频世界模型的物理保真度，涵盖22个受控任务族，揭示了两种模拟器中的系统性错误。
summary_zh: 物理引擎有助于实现具身智能的大规模训练与评估，而生成式视频世界模型正逐渐成为未来状态与交互的隐式模拟器。然而，现有对物理保真度的评估往往孤立进行，且严重依赖感知相似性或人类判断，难以揭示具体违反的物理原理或参数。我们提出GAUGE——一个基于真实世界数据的诊断性基准，用于联合评估数值模拟器与生成式视频世界模型在再现或偏离真实物理时的表现。该基准包含22个受控任务族，涵盖刚体、柔性线缆、纺织品及体积可变形物体。基于真实世界轨迹，并结合校准后的物理元数据、不确定性标注及任务特定观测值，这些任务覆盖了多种材料与条件下的基础物理过程，包括碰撞、摩擦、动量传递、振荡、自接触及变形。我们利用广义轨迹误差对Isaac Sim、Genesis和Newton在14个任务族上进行基准测试，并通过检验物理定律一致性及推断参数的时序稳定性，评估了6个图像到视频模型在5个刚体任务上的表现。结果表明，不存在完全保真的物理引擎，最大偏差出现在冲击接触、快速纺织品运动及体积变形中。我们进一步发现，视频世界模型虽能生成具有预期方程形式的轨迹，却可能恢复出错误的加速度、动量传递及振荡时序。GAUGE为开发更具物理保真度的模拟器与世界模型奠定了具身智能发展的基础。

title: Robust-WAM: Bridging Generative Pretraining and Semantic Foresight in World-Action Models
summary: Mainstream World-Action Models (WAMs) adapt pretrained video generation models (VGMs) for robot control, transferring their learned dynamics prior for action prediction. These VGMs are typically trained in a variational autoencoder (VAE) latent space. However, the VAE latent space is optimized for pixel reconstruction, which rewards fine appearance detail and leaves the action prediction fragile under visual shifts. Recent works build WAMs in semantic latent space, which are more robust to appearance shifts. However, these models cannot leverage the large-scale VGM pretraining that exists only in VAE space. To overcome this dilemma, we propose Robust-WAM, a general post-training method for video-generation-based WAMs that preserves the VAE-based generative path and adds a lightweight semantic foresight alignment objective on the action stream. This retains the large-scale VGM pretraining while grounding actions in appearance-invariant dynamics that stay reliable under illumination shifts and other visual out-of-distribution conditions. Specifically, we employ learnable query tokens to bring future-scene semantics into the action stream by aligning their output hidden states with the semantic foresight of future ground-truth frames. To establish the temporal correspondence between each query and the future step it describes, we give it the positional encoding of the matching action tokens. Experiments on out-of-distribution generalization simulation benchmarks and a real-robot setup show that our Robust-WAM consistently improves the success rates of multiple WAM baselines without sacrificing in-distribution performance.
tldr: Robust-WAM introduces a post-training method that aligns action-stream hidden states with semantic foresight from future frames, enabling video-generation-based world-action models to maintain pretrained dynamics while improving robustness to visual out-of-distribution shifts.
tldr_zh: Robust-WAM 提出了一种后训练方法，将动作流隐藏状态与未来帧的语义前瞻对齐，使得基于视频生成的世界动作模型在保持预训练动力学的同时，提升对视觉分布外变化的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 主流世界-动作模型（WAMs）通过适配预训练视频生成模型（VGMs）实现机器人控制，将其学习到的动力学先验迁移至动作预测。这类VGMs通常在变分自编码器（VAE）潜空间中进行训练。然而，VAE潜空间针对像素重建进行了优化，虽然保留了精细的表观细节，但也导致动作预测在视觉偏移下变得脆弱。近期研究在语义潜空间中构建WAMs，使其对表观偏移更具鲁棒性，但这类模型无法利用仅存在于VAE空间的大规模VGM预训练。为解决这一困境，我们提出Robust-WAM——一种面向视频生成型WAMs的通用后训练方法，该方法在保留基于VAE的生成路径的同时，在动作流上添加轻量级语义前瞻对齐目标。这使得模型既能保留大规模VGM预训练能力，又能将动作锚定在表观不变的动力学特征上，从而在光照变化等视觉分布外条件下保持可靠性。具体而言，我们采用可学习查询令牌，通过将其输出隐藏状态与未来真实帧的语义预测对齐，将未来场景语义引入动作流。为建立每个查询令牌与其所描述未来步骤之间的时间对应关系，我们为其赋予匹配动作令牌的位置编码。在分布外泛化仿真基准测试及真实机器人平台上的实验表明，Robust-WAM可在不牺牲分布内性能的前提下，持续提升多种WAM基线方法的任务成功率。

title: Hijacking Robots with a Piece of Paper: A Systematic Study of Physical Prompt Injection in VLM-Controlled Robots
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as planners in robotic systems, where they translate natural-language commands into executable actions grounded in visual scene understanding. This tight coupling between perception and instruction-following introduces a new attack surface: adversarial text placed within the robot's visual field can act as an indirect prompt injection into the VLM's reasoning stack. We present a systematic study of physical prompt injection attacks against VLM-controlled sorting, introducing a four-category taxonomy, indirect signage, task redefinition, authority impersonation, and conflict injection, instantiated as a benchmark of 20 attack prompts evaluated across three physical scene layouts and three command formulations that vary in destination specificity and rule explicitness. Across 5,670 trials on three frontier VLMs (GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Qwen3-VL-32B), attacks succeed at 27.0%, 29.4%, and 5.0% respectively, with authority-impersonating and negation attacks transferring across all three models. Analysis of reasoning traces reveals that successful compromise is nearly always conscious (99.9% acknowledgment rate), and that models defend through structurally different mechanisms, explicit rejection for Gemini, perceptual inattention for GPT-4o. We evaluate three simple mitigations: prompt-based defense (75-100% effective, model-dependent), two-stage verification (85-100%), and pre-processing text masking (100%). Our findings show that VLM-controlled manipulation is meaningfully vulnerable to human-readable physical signage, and that simple defenses substantially reduce risk, though defense choice involves trade-offs. The defenses preserve general task capabilities in our benchmark, but they may impair tasks that require reading in-scene labels.
tldr: A systematic study of physical prompt injection attacks against VLM-controlled robots, showing that adversarial text in the visual field can hijack robot behavior, with success rates up to 29.4% across frontier VLMs, and evaluating simple mitigations.
tldr_zh: 系统性研究了针对VLM控制机器人进行的物理提示注入攻击，表明视觉范围内的对抗性文本可以劫持机器人行为，在先进VLM上攻击成功率高达29.4%，并评估了简单防御措施。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）正越来越多地被部署为机器人系统中的规划器，它们将自然语言指令转化为基于视觉场景理解的可执行动作。感知与指令执行之间的这种紧密耦合引入了一个新的攻击面：放置在机器人视野内的对抗性文本，可作为对VLM推理堆栈的间接提示注入。我们针对VLM控制的分拣任务开展了物理提示注入攻击的系统性研究，提出了一种四类分类法——间接标识、任务重定义、权威冒充和冲突注入——并以20个攻击提示的基准测试集加以实例化，在三种物理场景布局和三种在目的地具体性与规则明确性上不同的指令表述下进行评估。在三个前沿VLM（GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Qwen3-VL-32B）上进行的5,670次试验中，攻击成功率分别为27.0%、29.4%和5.0%，其中权威冒充和否定类攻击在所有三个模型间具有可迁移性。对推理轨迹的分析表明，成功的入侵几乎总是有意识的（99.9%的承认率），且模型通过结构不同的机制进行防御：Gemini采用显式拒绝，GPT-4o则依赖感知性忽视。我们评估了三种简单的缓解措施：基于提示的防御（效果75-100%，依赖模型）、两阶段验证（85-100%）以及预处理文本掩码（100%）。我们的研究结果表明，VLM控制的操作系统容易受到人类可读物理标识的有效攻击，而简单的防御措施能显著降低风险，尽管防御方案的选择涉及权衡。在我们的基准测试中，这些防御手段保留了通用任务能力，但可能会削弱需要读取场景内标签的任务。

title: KILVO: Kinematic-Inertial-LiDAR-Visual Odometry with Robust Multimodal Adaptation for Humanoid Robots
summary: This article presents a kinematic-inertial-LiDAR-visual odometry for humanoid robots, called KILVO. Tailored to the platform features, requirements, and real-world complexity, it fully utilizes the sensors commonly equipped on humanoid robots, including joint encoders, IMU, LiDAR, and camera, within an asynchronous-sequential hybrid error-state iterated Kalman filter (ESIKF). Specifically, inertial data are used for prediction, leg kinematics are processed asynchronously at a high rate and provide proprioceptive constraints, while exteroception is updated sequentially, first by registering LiDAR points for geometric priors and then by updating the visual component via photometric errors. Moreover, the framework is elaborately designed with multimodal adaptation for resilience to sensor failures. A compact contact estimation module is also developed, sharing information with state estimation without additional sensors. Extensive experiments on public datasets and in the real world across multiple humanoid robots, gait patterns, and scenarios demonstrate that KILVO achieves highly competitive accuracy, efficiency, and output rates, with strong robustness against sensor degradation and failures, making it more suitable for humanoid robots than state-of-the-art fusion methods. Our code and datasets are released on GitHub.
tldr: KILVO is a multi-sensor fusion odometry framework for humanoid robots that integrates kinematic, inertial, LiDAR, and visual data with robust adaptation to sensor failures, achieving high accuracy and robustness across diverse gaits.
tldr_zh: KILVO是一个面向人形机器人的多传感器融合里程计框架，融合运动学、惯性、激光雷达和视觉数据，具备对传感器故障的鲁棒适应性，在不同步态下实现高精度和鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种适用于仿人机器人的运动学-惯性-激光-视觉里程计方法，命名为KILVO。该方法针对平台特性、应用需求及实际环境复杂性，在异步-顺序混合误差状态迭代卡尔曼滤波器（ESIKF）框架下，充分利用仿人机器人常规配置的传感器，包括关节编码器、惯性测量单元、激光雷达和相机。具体而言，惯性数据用于状态预测，腿部运动学以高频率异步处理并提供本体感知约束，而外部感知则通过顺序更新实现：首先通过激光雷达点云配准获取几何先验，继而利用光度误差更新视觉分量。此外，该框架经过精心设计，具备多模态自适应能力以应对传感器故障。研究还开发了紧凑的接触估计模块，无需额外传感器即可与状态估计共享信息。在公开数据集及真实环境中，基于多种仿人机器人、步态模式及场景的广泛实验表明，KILVO在精度、效率与输出频率方面均具有高度竞争力，且对传感器性能退化与故障表现出强鲁棒性，相较于现有最优融合方法更适用于仿人机器人。相关代码与数据集已发布于GitHub。

title: PathCover: A Fast Convex Decomposition along a Path via Randomized Iterative Space Partitioning (RISP) on Point Clouds
summary: Autonomous robot navigation requires the rapid generation of obstacle-free regions for trajectory planning. However, existing corridor generators struggle to meet real-time, sensor-rate computational constraints. To resolve this bottleneck, we introduce PathCover, a framework driven by RISP; a novel randomized algorithm that constructs convex polytopes directly from raw point cloud data in expected linear time under a mild probabilistic elimination condition. PathCover generates sequences of overlapping, obstacle-free polytopes that safely constrain downstream MPC and trajectory optimization. We mathematically guarantee that the algorithm terminates in finite steps while ensuring continuous progress along any obstacle-free reference path. Extensive benchmarks on synthetic and real-world LiDAR datasets demonstrate an order-of-magnitude speedup over state-of-the-art methods while maintaining comparable corridor volumes. The complete pipeline is validated via high-fidelity quadrotor simulations and physical deployment on a quadrupedal robot navigating constrained environments using live LiDAR perception.
tldr: PathCover introduces a randomized algorithm (RISP) that constructs obstacle-free convex polytopes from point clouds in expected linear time, enabling real-time motion planning for autonomous robots.
tldr_zh: PathCover 提出了一种随机算法 (RISP)，可从点云中在线性时间内构建无障碍凸多面体，从而实现自主机器人的实时运动规划。
summary_zh: 自主机器人导航需要快速生成无障碍区域以进行轨迹规划。然而，现有走廊生成器难以满足实时传感器级的计算约束。为解决这一瓶颈，我们提出了PathCover——一种由RISP驱动的框架；该框架采用一种新颖的随机化算法，可直接从原始点云数据中构建凸多面体，在温和的概率消除条件下，其期望时间复杂度为线性。PathCover可生成一系列重叠的无障碍多面体，从而安全约束下游的模型预测控制与轨迹优化。我们从数学上保证该算法在有限步内终止，同时确保沿任意无障碍参考路径的持续进展。在合成数据集与真实激光雷达数据集上的广泛基准测试表明，该方法在保持可比走廊体积的同时，实现了比现有先进方法快一个数量级的加速。通过高保真四旋翼仿真实验，以及在采用实时激光雷达感知的约束环境中部署四足机器人进行物理实验，完整流程得到了验证。

title: ARGUS: Aligning Robot Scene Geometry Under Shifting Views with Large 3D Vision Models
summary: Large-scale visuomotor policies have demonstrated impressive performance across a wide range of robot manipulation tasks. However, despite this success, manipulation polices often entangle scene geometry with the corresponding viewpoint, learning where objects lie in an image rather than where it lies in the task space. This entanglement inherently limits the corresponding policy's ability to learn from viewpoint-diverse datasets (ex. DROID, BridgeV2) and generalize beyond the viewpoints captured in their training data. In this work, we present ARGUS, an observation pre-processing pipeline that uses large-scale 3D vision models to align image observations from arbitrary camera viewpoints into a canonical viewpoint before passing it to downstream visuomotor policies. Experiments across training datasets with varying levels of viewpoint diversity, from fixed multi-view camera configurations to highly varied camera placements, show that our method consistently outperforms prior approaches across both limited-view and view-diverse training regimes. In efficiency comparisons, ARGUS demonstrates an ability to learn from view-diverse data, converging to high success rates 4-6x faster than previous methods by leveraging a simplified observation space. Overall, our findings show that leveraging large-scale 3D vision models reduces the learning burden on visuomotor policies, enabling more efficient learning from large-scale, viewpoint-diverse robot datasets.
tldr: ARGUS is an observation pre-processing pipeline that uses large 3D vision models to re-project arbitrary camera viewpoints into a canonical view, enabling visuomotor policies to learn more efficiently from viewpoint-diverse robot datasets.
tldr_zh: ARGUS是一个观测预处理流程，利用大型3D视觉模型将任意相机视角的图像重新投影到标准视角，从而使视觉运动策略能够更有效地从视角多样的机器人数据集中学习。
summary_zh: 大规模视觉-运动策略已在多种机器人操作任务中展现出令人瞩目的性能。然而，尽管取得了这一成功，操作策略常常将场景几何形状与对应视角混为一谈，学习的是图像中物体的位置，而非其在任务空间中的位置。这种缠绕本质上限制了相应策略从视角多样化数据集（如DROID、BridgeV2）中学习的能力，以及泛化到训练数据所捕获视角之外的能力。在本工作中，我们提出ARGUS——一种观测预处理流水线，它利用大规模3D视觉模型，将来自任意相机视角的图像观测对齐到规范视角，再将其传递至下游视觉-运动策略。在从固定多视角相机配置到高度变化的相机位置等不同视角多样性的训练数据集上进行的实验表明，我们的方法在有限视角和视角多样化训练场景中均持续优于先前方法。在效率对比中，ARGUS展现出从视角多样化数据中学习的能力，通过利用简化的观测空间，其收敛到高成功率的速度比先前方法快4-6倍。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，利用大规模3D视觉模型可减轻视觉-运动策略的学习负担，从而能够从大规模、视角多样化的机器人数据集中实现更高效的学习。

title: ErgoSurf: Ergodic Control for the Coverage of Unknown Surfaces
summary: Contact-centric tasks on surfaces, ranging from inspection and cleaning to sanding and polishing, require robots to systematically cover the surface while maintaining stable contact. Ergodic control generates trajectories that spend time at a location proportional to a desired, task-specific spatial distribution, enabling efficient information gathering and coverage. However, traditional ergodic control methods rely on prior knowledge of surface geometry or require a vision sensory input to scan the geometry beforehand, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios with unknown or dynamic environments. This paper introduces a novel online ergodic control framework that achieves systematic surface coverage while simultaneously reconstructing unknown surface geometry. We employ a Gaussian Process Implicit Surface (GPIS) model that learns global surface geometry from intrinsic tactile sensing during execution. For efficient online planning, we approximate the surface locally using point clouds sampled from tangent planes at observed contact points and iteratively fit them to the Gaussian Process. This approximation simultaneously serves as the sampling domain for both the target and the coverage distributions. We employ a heat-diffusion analogy to compute potential fields that guide ergodic exploration, translating spatial coverage objectives into smooth robot trajectories. We demonstrate our framework through simulation and real-robot experiments, validating simultaneous ergodic coverage and online surface geometry learning with reconstruction errors approaching the ground truth.
tldr: ErgoSurf introduces an online ergodic control framework that uses tactile sensing and Gaussian Process Implicit Surfaces to simultaneously cover and reconstruct unknown surface geometry for contact-centric tasks.
tldr_zh: ErgoSurf 提出了一种在线遍历控制框架，利用触觉感知和高斯过程隐式表面同时覆盖和重建未知表面几何形状，用于接触性任务。
summary_zh: 接触类表面作业任务，从检查、清洁到打磨抛光，都要求机器人在保持稳定接触的同时系统性地覆盖整个表面。遍历控制能够生成符合特定任务空间分布的轨迹，使机器人在每个位置的驻留时间与期望的空间分布成正比，从而高效实现信息采集与覆盖。然而，传统遍历控制方法依赖表面前置几何知识或需要视觉传感器预先扫描几何信息，这限制了其在未知或动态环境真实场景中的应用。本文提出一种新颖的在线遍历控制框架，可在系统性地完成表面覆盖的同时，同步重建未知表面几何结构。我们采用高斯过程隐式曲面模型，在执行过程中通过内部触觉传感学习全局表面几何特征。为实现高效在线规划，我们利用观测接触点切平面采样的点云对局部表面进行近似，并通过迭代将点云拟合至高斯过程。该近似同时作为目标分布与覆盖分布的采样域。通过类比热扩散过程，我们计算引导遍历探索的势场，将空间覆盖目标转化为平滑的机器人运动轨迹。通过仿真与真实机器人实验验证，该框架实现了同步遍历覆盖与在线表面几何学习，重建误差接近真实值水平。

title: Visual Grounding in Zero-Shot Vision-Language Control
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as zero-shot controllers, but successful trajectories do not necessarily show that decisions are grounded in visual input: simulator dynamics and conservative action priors can produce favourable scores without meaningful perception. We investigate this with an input-ablation battery: blind-image controls, repeated identical inputs, lane-axis reflection, non-visual baselines, and pipeline-integrity checks. Across nine direct-action models, six structured local VLMs, and an exploratory VLM-MPC hierarchy, we analyse 32,874 scored calls over two embodiments and three simulators. The direct-control results are largely negative: a constant-SLOW policy outperforms a scripted geometric controller, several models are image-invariant or nearly constant, and models that recognize longitudinal hazards still fail to transform LEFT and RIGHT under reflection. No local VLM meets the joint longitudinal and lateral grounding criteria. However, an image-only deterministic positive control estimates the lead gap with 0.090 m MAE and exact mirror equivariance, confirming the stimuli carry sufficient visual information; the failures are modular, not universal. A post-hoc, leakage-controlled symmetry-consensus guardian selects two models from 16 calibration frames and freezes a 2-of-4 hazard vote across original and reflected views. On 272 held-out frames it reaches 0.954 balanced accuracy (episode-cluster bootstrap 95% CI [0.895,0.990]); nested leave-one-episode-out recovers the same pair and threshold in all 12 folds. Abstaining on ties raises committed balanced accuracy to 0.973 at 0.824 coverage. With deterministic perception retaining lateral authority, offline modular replay achieves 0.934 action agreement and exact mirror equivariance. These results support current VLMs as bounded, selective hazard assistants, not monolithic zero-shot controllers.
tldr: This paper proposes an input-ablation battery to evaluate whether zero-shot vision-language controllers truly ground decisions in visual input, finding most models fail lateral grounding; it introduces a symmetry-consensus guardian that achieves high accuracy and exact mirror equivariance, suggesting VLMs are better as bounded hazard assistants than monolithic controllers.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种输入消融测试组，用于评估零样本视觉语言控制器是否真正基于视觉输入做出决策，发现大多数模型在横向接地方面失败；引入的对称共识守卫实现了高精度和精确的镜像等变性，表明VLM更适合作为有边界的安全辅助工具而非整体控制器。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型正越来越多地被用作零样本控制器，但成功的轨迹并不必然表明决策基于视觉输入：模拟器动力学和保守的动作先验可以在没有有意义感知的情况下产生有利的分数。我们通过输入消融测试组对此进行了研究：盲图像控制、重复的相同输入、车道轴反射、非视觉基线以及流程完整性检查。在九个直接动作模型、六个结构化局部视觉-语言模型和一个探索性的视觉-语言模型-模型预测控制层次结构中，我们分析了在两个实体和三个模拟器上的32,874次评分调用。直接控制的结果在很大程度上是负面的：恒定-慢速策略优于脚本化的几何控制器；多个模型对图像不变或近乎恒定；能够识别纵向风险的模型在反射条件下仍无法转换左和右指令。没有局部视觉-语言模型满足联合纵向和横向接地标准。然而，一个纯图像确定性正向控制以0.090米平均绝对误差和精确镜像等变性估计了前车间距，确认了这些刺激携带足够的视觉信息；这些失败是模块化的，而非普遍性的。一个事后、泄漏控制的对称共识守护者从16个标定帧中选择两个模型，并在原始视图和反射视图之间冻结一个2/4的风险投票。在272个保留帧上，它达到了0.954的均衡准确率（情节聚类自助法95%置信区间[0.895, 0.990]）；嵌套的留一情节法在所有12折中恢复出相同的模型对和阈值。在平局时弃权，使承诺的均衡准确率在0.824覆盖率下提升至0.973。在确定性感知保留横向权限的情况下，离线模块化重放实现了0.934的动作一致性以及精确镜像等变性。这些结果支持当前视觉-语言模型作为有界限、选择性的风险辅助工具，而非整体的零样本控制器。

title: Topometric Autonomous Vehicle Localization by Combining Visual Embeddings and Feed-Forward 3D Models
summary: Effective Visual Localization (VL) requires a map of the environment that combines compactness for efficient scalability with robustness against visual appearance changes and metric precision. Through low-dimensional image embeddings, Visual Place Recognition (VPR) is able to successfully meet the first two requirements, but its low metric accuracy makes it less suitable than standard VL approaches based on local features or neural representations. This limitation can be overcome by integrating VPR with the accurate local trajectory estimates produced by feed-forward neural 3D geometry (FF3D) models. In this paper, we address sequential appearance-based localization through a topometric framework that iteratively combines probabilistic VPR with FF3D metric pose estimation in controlled image sets. Our approach proposes an automatic offline mapping tool that models the topometric pose-appearance interaction in the different parts of the scene. This map is later employed by an online particle filter that estimates the pose from odometry and belief over places for FF3D inference, successfully incorporating neural metric estimation into probabilistic appearance-based localization. We extensively evaluate the framework on three known benchmarks, demonstrating substantial improvements over existing appearance-based methods. The modularity of our approach allows the descriptor extractor and FF3D model to remain interchangeable, and a focused analysis further shows that sequential belief can mitigate severe failures under perceptual aliasing.
tldr: This paper presents a topometric localization framework that combines probabilistic Visual Place Recognition with feed-forward neural 3D pose estimation, enabling robust and metric-accurate autonomous vehicle localization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种拓扑度量定位框架，将概率性视觉地点识别与前馈神经3D位姿估计相结合，实现了鲁棒且具有度量精度的自动驾驶车辆定位。
summary_zh: 有效的视觉定位需要构建环境地图，该地图需兼顾紧凑性（以实现高效可扩展性）、对视觉外观变化的鲁棒性以及度量精度。通过低维图像嵌入，视觉位置识别能够成功满足前两个要求，但其度量精度较低，使其不如基于局部特征或神经表征的标准视觉定位方法适合。这一局限可通过将视觉位置识别与前馈式神经三维几何模型生成的精确局部轨迹估计相结合来克服。本文通过一种拓扑度量框架解决基于序列外观的定位问题，该框架在受控图像集中迭代结合概率性视觉位置识别与前馈式神经三维几何模型的度量位姿估计。我们提出了一种自动离线建图工具，用于建模场景不同区域中拓扑度量位姿-外观的交互作用。该地图随后被在线粒子滤波器使用，该滤波器通过里程计与基于位置置信度（用于前馈式神经三维几何推理）来估计位姿，成功将神经度量估计整合到基于外观的概率定位中。我们在三个知名基准上对该框架进行了广泛评估，结果表明其相较于现有基于外观的方法有显著提升。该方法模块化设计使得描述符提取器与前馈式神经三维几何模型可互换使用，进一步针对性分析表明，序列置信度可有效缓解感知混淆下的严重故障。

title: Unified Planning-Learning Framework for Robust UUV Navigation Under Partial Observability
summary: This paper presents an observation-only autonomy framework for Unmanned Underwater Vehicles (UUVs) navigation in dynamic underwater environments that integrates persistent occupancy mapping, global clearance-aware planning, and risk-aware local control. The proposed pipeline constructs occupancy maps solely from onboard sonar and depth image observations, adapts a clearance-constrained global planner (GP) to provide long-horizon structure, and integrates a reinforcement learning (RL) policy to handle short-range tracking and reactive avoidance. To further support decision-making under partial observability, the system learns a compact latent state representation from onboard sensor data, encoding environmental structure, obstacle dynamics, and uncertainty. Behavior tree (BT) distillation with staged supervision is introduced to improve safety and training stability, while an uncertainty-calibrated distillation mechanism reweights teacher guidance using online latent-model uncertainty, emphasizing uncertain regimes during learning, with time-to-collision (TTC) and clearance cues remaining explicit in planning and local policy features. To demonstrate the efficacy of the framework, a reproducible multi-seed evaluation protocol is established in high-fidelity GPU-accelerated simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, and performance is benchmarked against BT-only and standard RL baselines. The results obtained demonstrate improved robustness and safety under dynamic conditions, thus providing a general pipeline with a unified hybrid planning learning architecture and a reproducible methodology for robust UUV autonomy under partial observability.
tldr: The paper presents a hybrid planning-learning framework integrating occupancy mapping, clearance-aware planning, and RL-based local control for robust UUV navigation under partial observability, with behavior tree distillation and uncertainty calibration.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种结合占据映射、间隙感知全局规划与强化学习局部控制的混合规划学习框架，通过行为树蒸馏与不确定性校准实现水下机器人在部分可观测条件下的鲁棒导航。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种面向动态水下环境中的无人水下航行器（UUV）导航的纯观测自主框架，该框架融合了持久性占据映射、全局间隙感知规划以及风险感知的局部控制。所提出的流程仅利用船载声纳与深度图像观测构建占据地图，采用具有间隙约束的全局规划器（GP）以提供长时域结构，并集成强化学习（RL）策略以实现短程跟踪与反应式避障。为支撑部分可观测条件下的决策，系统从船载传感器数据中学习紧凑的潜在状态表征，以编码环境结构、障碍物动态及不确定性。引入具有阶段性监督的行为树（BT）蒸馏机制以提升安全性与训练稳定性，同时提出一种不确定性校准的蒸馏方法，利用在线潜在模型的不确定性对教师指导进行重新加权，在训练过程中突出不确定性较大的场景，并在规划与局部策略特征中保持碰撞时间（TTC）与间隙线索的显式表达。为验证该框架的有效性，利用NVIDIA Isaac Sim在高保真GPU加速仿真环境中建立了可复现的多随机种子评估协议，并以仅依赖BT和标准RL的基线方法为基准进行性能对比。实验结果表明，所提方法在动态条件下提升了鲁棒性与安全性，从而为部分可观测环境下鲁棒的UUV自主运行提供了一种统一的混合规划学习架构及可复现的通用流程。

title: LoDA: A Level of Detection Aware Method and a Multimodal Sensing Benchmark for Object Level Change Detection
summary: High-definition 3D LiDAR maps are important for autonomous driving and smart-city services, which require reliable detection of object-level changes in multi-temporal urban LiDAR to keep digital maps aligned with the physical world. Existing approaches from raster height differencing to depth image and point-cloud networks often remain tile-based and threshold-driven, yielding per-point scores without explicit detection limits or consistent object-level labels. We propose an object-level 3D change-detection pipeline that integrates detection-limit-aware registration, geometry-driven object proxies with rule-based semantic and instance segmentation, and displacement cues in height, volume, and surface-normal direction to assign five change labels with confidence. By decoupling registration, geometry, and semantics, the pipeline propagates pose uncertainty into spatially varying detection limits, stabilizes cross-epoch correspondences, and suppresses false changes caused by residual misalignment and density variation. We also present LoDA, a level-of-detection (LoD) aware benchmark for the Subiaco district with fused multi-temporal vehicle-LiDAR maps constructed with LiDAR, GNSS, and IMU support, semantic instances, and object-level annotations. On this benchmark, our method achieves 95.0% accuracy, 90.8% macro F1, and 83.0% macro IoU, exceeding the best baseline by 8.7 IoU points and 4.4 F1 points. On the public Urb3DCD-V2 benchmark evaluated under the official point-wise protocol, it reaches 96.81% mean accuracy and 89.52% mean change IoU, improving over the strongest reported baselines by 1.36 points in mAcc and 3.18 points in mIoUch.
tldr: This paper proposes an object-level 3D change detection pipeline for HD LiDAR maps in autonomous driving, integrating detection-limit-aware registration and a multimodal benchmark, achieving high accuracy on urban change detection.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向自动驾驶高清LiDAR地图的目标级三维变化检测管线，融合检测限感知配准与多模态基准，在城市变化检测上取得了高精度。
summary_zh: 高分辨率三维激光雷达地图对自动驾驶和智慧城市服务至关重要，这类服务需要可靠地检测多时相城市激光雷达数据中的对象级变化，以保持数字地图与物理世界的一致性。现有方法从栅格高程差分到深度图像和点云网络，往往基于分块处理和阈值驱动，输出逐点得分，缺乏明确的检测限或一致的对象级标签。本文提出一种对象级三维变化检测流程，该流程集成了检测限感知的配准方法、基于几何驱动的对象代理（结合规则化语义与实例分割），以及高度、体积和法向位移线索，从而赋予五个变化标签及其置信度。通过解耦配准、几何与语义，该流程将位姿不确定性传播至空间变化的检测限中，稳定跨时期的对应关系，并抑制由残余失配和密度变化引起的虚假变化。此外，我们提出了LoDA——一个针对Subiaco地区的检测层次感知基准，包含基于激光雷达、GNSS和IMU构建的多时相车载激光雷达融合地图、语义实例及对象级标注。在该基准上，我们的方法实现了95.0%的准确率、90.8%的宏平均F1分数和83.0%的宏平均IoU，分别超过最佳基线8.7个IoU点和4.4个F1点。在官方逐点评估协议下的公开Urb3DCD-V2基准上，该方法达到了96.81%的平均准确率和89.52%的平均变化IoU，较已报告的最强基线在mAcc和mIoUch上分别提升了1.36个点和3.18个点。

title: iARCS: Iterative Agentic RL for Controllable 3D Scene Generation
summary: Synthetic 3D scene generation is increasingly used as a data source for computer vision and embodied AI, but existing generators often optimize perceptual realism without reliably satisfying task-critical functional constraints. This mismatch limits the usefulness of synthetic data for downstream training, where accessibility, traversability, and spatial rule compliance are often essential. We present iARCS, an iterative agentic reinforcement learning framework that adapts a pretrained scene generator to natural-language task requirements. iARCS uses a two-stage strategy: universal-reward pretraining to improve physical plausibility and layout quality, followed by task-specific fine-tuning with LLM-generated reward programs that are iteratively refined from training feedback. Experiments show improved constraint fidelity on walkability, reachability, and clearance-focused tasks, effective task-specific constraint optimization, and competitive scene diversity. We further show that data generated by iARCS improves a base generator, supporting its value as a practical synthetic data generation tool rather than only a controllable scene editing method.
tldr: iARCS uses iterative agentic RL with LLM-generated reward programs to adapt 3D scene generators to natural-language task constraints like walkability and reachability, improving the utility of synthetic data for embodied AI training.
tldr_zh: iARCS 利用迭代式强化学习与 LLM 生成的奖励程序，使 3D 场景生成器适应自然语言指定的任务约束（如可通行性和可达性），从而提升合成数据在具身 AI 训练中的实用性。
summary_zh: 合成三维场景生成正日益成为计算机视觉与具身智能的数据来源，但现有生成器往往在优化感知真实感的同时，未能可靠地满足任务关键的功能约束。这种不匹配限制了合成数据在下游训练中的实用性——而可及性、可通行性及空间规则符合性通常是这些任务的核心要求。我们提出iARCS，一种迭代式智能体强化学习框架，能将预训练的场景生成器适配至自然语言任务需求。iARCS采用两阶段策略：通用奖励预训练提升物理合理性与布局质量，随后通过大语言模型生成的奖励程序进行任务特定微调，该程序会根据训练反馈迭代优化。实验表明，该方法在可步行性、可达性及净空相关任务中提升了约束保真度，实现了高效的任务特定约束优化，并保持了具有竞争力的场景多样性。我们进一步证明，iARCS生成的数据能够增强基础生成器，使其不仅是一种可控的场景编辑方法，更成为实用的合成数据生成工具。

title: Design and Evaluation of a Touchscreen-Based Teleoperation Interface for Robotic Manipulators
summary:
Intuitive teleoperation interfaces are crucial for the safe and effective operation of robotic manipulators in challenging environments. In the nuclear industry, surface contact tasks such as swab sampling require precise path and force tracking, obstacle avoidance, and sustained operator attention, which conventional joystick interfaces struggle to support effectively.
  This study designs and evaluates a novel touchscreen teleoperation interface that maps continuous finger movements directly to robotic manipulator motions, provides finer velocity control, and integrates control with visualization, enabling more natural, precise, and intuitive surface interaction than conventional controllers. A comparative user study with 20 participants evaluated task performance and workload using the proposed touchscreen, a conventional joystick, and a single-click autonomous mode. Tasks simulated realistic surface manipulation using a Franka Emika Panda arm, remotely controlled from another country. Kinematic, physiological, and behavioral data were recorded to comprehensively assess task performance, cognitive load, and operator trust across each control condition.
  Participants completed teleoperation tasks more efficiently and accurately with the touchscreen interface, achieving a 53.5% reduction in completion time (median: 2.50 vs. 5.38 min), higher in-area coverage on the sinusoidal path (90.7% vs. 84.1%), and lower overshoot on both path geometries compared with the joystick. Cognitive load, quantified via NASA-TLX (0-100), decreased from joystick to touchscreen (mean TLX 52 to 43; -9 points, -17.3%) and was lowest under the autonomous one-click mode (31; -21 points vs. joystick, -40.4%; -12 vs. touchscreen, -27.9%). This research presents an easy-to-implement touchscreen interface that improves performance in teleoperated surface tasks while reducing cognitive load.
tldr: This paper presents a touchscreen-based teleoperation interface for robotic manipulators, showing improved task efficiency, accuracy, and reduced cognitive load compared to joystick control in a user study with a Franka Emika Panda arm.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于触摸屏的机器人遥操作界面，通过用户研究（使用Franka Emika Panda机械臂）证明其相比摇杆控制能提高任务效率和准确性，并降低认知负荷。
summary_zh:
直观的遥操作接口对于在复杂环境中安全、高效地操作机器人机械臂至关重要。在核工业中，诸如拭子采样等表面接触任务需要精确的路径与力跟踪、避障以及操作员的持续注意力，而传统的操纵杆接口难以有效支持这些需求。

本研究设计并评估了一种新型触摸屏遥操作接口，该接口将连续的手指运动直接映射为机器人机械臂的运动，提供更精细的速度控制，并将控制与可视化相结合，从而比传统控制器实现更自然、更精确、更直观的表面交互。一项包含20名参与者的对比用户研究评估了使用所提触摸屏、传统操纵杆以及单次点击自主模式时的任务表现与工作负荷。研究任务使用一台Franka Emika Panda机械臂模拟了真实的表面操作，该机械臂从另一个国家远程控制。研究记录了运动学、生理学和行为学数据，以全面评估每种控制条件下的任务表现、认知负荷及操作员信任度。

参与者使用触摸屏接口更高效、更准确地完成了遥操作任务，与操纵杆相比，完成时间减少了53.5%（中位数：2.50分钟 vs. 5.38分钟），在正弦路径上的区域内覆盖率更高（90.7% vs. 84.1%），且在两种路径几何形状下的超调量均更低。通过NASA-TLX（0-100分）量化的认知负荷从操纵杆模式降至触摸屏模式（平均TLX从52降至43；降低9分，降幅17.3%），并在单次点击自主模式下达到最低（31分；比操纵杆低21分，降幅40.4%；比触摸屏低12分，降幅27.9%）。本研究提出了一种易于实现的触摸屏接口，在降低认知负荷的同时，改善了遥操作表面任务的执行表现。

title: Observation-Grounded Self-Predictive Reinforcement Learning for Visual Continuous Control
summary: Sample-efficient policy learning from pixels is a long-standing challenge in reinforcement learning (RL). Recent dynamics-based representation learning methods have significantly improved the sample efficiency of model-free visual RL by learning dynamics-aware representations through auxiliary prediction performed either in latent space (self-prediction) or observation space (observation prediction). However, state-of-the-art methods from both categories still struggle on challenging visual control tasks when training data is limited. We posit that relying on either predictive objective alone may be insufficient. In contrast, observation prediction grounds learned representations in observation-level dynamics, but does not directly regularize the temporal predictability of latent representations over extended horizons. In this paper, we propose Observation-Grounded Self-Predictive Representations (OG-SPR), a model-free visual RL algorithm for continuous control that learns representations that are both temporally predictive in latent space and grounded in observation-level dynamics. OG-SPR incorporates two core auxiliary objectives: multi-step latent self-prediction and next-observation prediction. We empirically show that directly imposing latent self-prediction on the shared representation may over-constrain it and does not necessarily improve performance. To address this issue, OG-SPR introduces two lightweight adapters for latent self-prediction, allowing the shared representation to benefit from temporally predictive signals without being forced to directly satisfy the self-prediction objective. Experiments on 28 visual control tasks from the DeepMind Control Suite show that OG-SPR improves aggregate performance over state-of-the-art self-predictive and observation-predictive RL methods, with particularly pronounced gains in challenging domains such as dog and humanoid.
tldr: Proposes OG-SPR, a model-free visual RL algorithm that combines latent self-prediction and observation prediction to learn temporally predictive yet observation-grounded representations, achieving state-of-the-art sample efficiency on 28 continuous control tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出OG-SPR，一种无模型视觉强化学习算法，结合潜在自预测和观测预测来学习既在时间上可预测又扎根于观测动态的表征，在28个连续控制任务上达到了最先进的样本效率。
summary_zh: 从像素数据中实现样本高效策略学习一直是强化学习（RL）中的长期挑战。近年来，基于动力学的表示学习方法通过在潜在空间（自预测）或观测空间（观测预测）中执行辅助预测来学习动力学感知表示，显著提升了无模型视觉强化学习的样本效率。然而，在训练数据有限的情况下，这两类方法中的最先进技术仍然在具有挑战性的视觉控制任务中表现不佳。我们认为，单独依赖任何一种预测目标可能是不够的。相比之下，观测预测将学习到的表示锚定在观测层面的动力学中，但无法直接正则化潜在表示在较长时序范围内的时间可预测性。本文提出观测锚定自预测表示（OG-SPR），这是一种用于连续控制的无模型视觉强化学习算法，其学习的表示既能在潜在空间中具备时间预测性，又能锚定在观测层面的动力学中。OG-SPR包含两个核心辅助目标：多步潜在自预测与下一观测预测。实验结果表明，在共享表示上直接施加潜在自预测可能会过度约束该表示，且未必能提升性能。为解决这一问题，OG-SPR引入了两个轻量级适配器用于潜在自预测，使共享表示能够受益于时间预测性信号，而无需强制直接满足自预测目标。在DeepMind控制套件中28个视觉控制任务上的实验表明，OG-SPR相较于最先进的自预测和观测预测强化学习方法在整体性能上有显著提升，尤其在狗和类人机器人等具有挑战性的领域中表现突出。

title: Near-sensor Computing for Rapid Visuotactile Perception
summary: Visuotactile sensors reconstruct dense contact geometry from measured surface gradients, but host-based processing increases power consumption and introduces data-transfer delays and variable scheduling latency, limiting the sensing and response speed of robotic systems. To address these limitations, we implement a near-sensor computing framework that includes a spectral Poisson solver as a fully streaming hardware pipeline. The computational core logic has an estimated power consumption of 347 mW and achieves high throughput without data-dependent branching or iterative convergence, thereby providing deterministic latency. Operating at 166 MHz, the pipeline produces the first depth value of each 128x128 frame 35,107 cycles after receiving the first input pixel, corresponding to a fixed latency of 0.211 ms. Across 15 contact geometries, the reconstructed depths differ from a double-precision reference by 0.17 % of the peak contact depth. On-chip decisions based on these reconstructions close a robot protective reflex loop in 28.3 +/- 4.9 ms, compared with 169.9 +/- 27.8 ms for an equivalent host-based loop using the same actuator. These results demonstrate that near-sensor reconstruction can provide accurate, energy-efficient, and deterministic tactile geometry on timescales suitable for rapid robotic contact responses.
tldr: This paper introduces a near-sensor computing framework with a streaming spectral Poisson solver for visuotactile sensors, achieving deterministic low-latency (0.211 ms) depth reconstruction and enabling fast robotic protective reflexes (28.3 ms) with low power (347 mW).
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种近传感器计算框架，采用流式频谱泊松求解器处理视触觉传感器数据，实现了确定性的低延迟（0.211毫秒）深度重建，并以347毫瓦的低功耗实现了快速的机器人保护性反射（28.3毫秒）。
summary_zh: 视觉触觉传感器通过测量表面梯度重建密集接触几何结构，但基于主机的处理会增加功耗、引入数据传输延迟和可变调度延迟，从而限制机器人系统的感知与响应速度。为解决这些局限，我们实现了一种近传感器计算框架，其中包含作为全流式硬件管线的谱泊松求解器。该计算核心逻辑的预估功耗为347毫瓦，可在不依赖数据分支或迭代收敛的情况下实现高吞吐量，从而提供确定性的延迟。在166 MHz运行频率下，该管线在接收到第一个输入像素后的35,107个时钟周期内生成每个128x128帧的首个深度值，对应0.211毫秒的固定延迟。在15种接触几何结构中，重建深度与双精度参考值的偏差仅为峰值接触深度的0.17%。基于这些重建结果的片上决策可在28.3±4.9毫秒内闭合机器人保护性反射回路，而使用相同执行器的等效主机回路则需要169.9±27.8毫秒。这些结果表明，近传感器重建能够以适用于快速机器人接触响应的时间尺度，提供准确、节能且确定性的触觉几何信息。

title: ATP: Anatomical Torque with Passivity-based Control Framework for Safe Upper-Limb Exoskeleton Assistance
summary: Providing assistance across diverse movements is a central objective of exoskeletons, and anatomical knowledge can enable responsive support that generalizes across tasks. However, anatomical assistance has mainly been studied for lower-limb exoskeletons, where periodic, weight-bearing motions impose lower demands on torque precision. Extending such assistance to complex, nonperiodic upper-limb movements remains challenging. This paper proposes Anatomical Torque with Passivity-Based Control (ATP) for safe upper-limb exoskeleton assistance. First, a scalable musculoskeletal simulation framework trains a unified reinforcement-learning muscle controller that generalizes across upper-limb movements and generates anatomical reference torques without complex biomechanical computations. Second, an online torque-refinement scheme adapts the reference to diverse movements, suppresses tendon-induced spikes, and incorporates a learned anomaly score for safe and comfortable assistance. Third, an interaction torque controller delivers assistance through a cable-driven compliant exoskeleton without constraining motion to predefined trajectories, while an energy tank preserves passivity with theoretical guarantees on torque tracking and system passivity. Simulations and real-world experiments show accurate tracking of long-duration motion sequences and generalization to real-time human movements. The controller achieves accurate torque tracking while preserving passivity and resumes tracking after energy-tank replenishment. An EMG study with five participants further shows reduced target-muscle activity during static and dynamic tasks compared with gravity compensation and open-loop assistance, with reductions of up to 48% relative to movement without the exoskeleton in a dynamic multi-joint task.
tldr: Proposes ATP, a passivity-based control framework with a musculoskeletal simulation-trained reinforcement learning muscle controller for safe upper-limb exoskeleton assistance, validated on a real cable-driven exoskeleton with human participants.
tldr_zh: 提出ATP框架，通过基于骨骼肌仿真的强化学习肌肉控制器和被动性控制，实现安全的上肢外骨骼辅助，并在真实线缆驱动外骨骼上进行了人体实验验证。
summary_zh: 为多样化运动提供辅助是外骨骼的核心目标，而解剖学知识能够实现跨任务泛化的响应式支撑。然而，解剖学辅助的研究主要集中于下肢外骨骼——这类周期性承重运动对力矩精度的要求较低。将此类辅助扩展到复杂的非周期性上肢运动仍具挑战性。本文提出基于无源性控制的解剖力矩（ATP）方法，用于实现安全的上肢外骨骼辅助。首先，通过可扩展的肌肉骨骼仿真框架训练统一的强化学习肌肉控制器，该控制器可泛化至各类上肢运动，无需复杂生物力学计算即可生成解剖参考力矩。其次，在线力矩优化机制可针对不同运动调整参考值，抑制肌腱诱发尖峰信号，并集成异常检测评分确保辅助的安全性与舒适性。第三，交互力矩控制器通过线驱动柔顺外骨骼传递辅助力，既不限制运动至预设轨迹，又通过能量池保持无源性，同时提供力矩跟踪与系统无源性的理论保证。仿真与真实实验表明，该方法可精准跟踪长时序运动序列，并泛化至实时人体运动。该控制器在保持无源性的同时实现精确力矩跟踪，且在能量池补充后恢复跟踪性能。针对五名参与者的肌电研究进一步显示，与重力补偿及开环辅助相比，该方法在静态与动态任务中均能降低目标肌肉活跃度——在动态多关节任务中，相对于无外骨骼运动最高可降低48%。

title: Nonvisual Classification of Ground-Condition by Artificial Proprioception in an Amoeba-Inspired Autonomous Walking Robot
summary: Nonvisual classification of ground condition based on a multimodal sensing approach was investigated for an amoeba-inspired autonomous walking robot. To classify ground condition without image sensing and processing, we implemented artificial proprioception by integrating a three-axis accelerometer, eight foot pressure sensors, and reservoir computing (RC). Even when large fluctuations in the sensor outputs are caused by dynamic motions of a four-legged robot in walking, our system can classify the ground condition, flat or rough, with high accuracy. We demonstrate on-site switching of walking gait depending on ground condition in the robot. We also discuss the contribution of each sensor to ground condition classification.
tldr: This paper presents a nonvisual method for classifying ground conditions (flat or rough) using artificial proprioception with accelerometer and pressure sensors plus reservoir computing on an amoeba-inspired walking robot, enabling on-site gait switching.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种非视觉地面分类方法，通过人工本体感觉（加速度计、足部压力传感器）和储层计算在类变形虫步行机器人上实现高精度分类，并支持步态实时切换。
summary_zh: 基于多模态感知方法，本研究针对仿变形虫自主行走机器人开展了地面条件的非视觉分类研究。为实现无需图像感知与处理的地面条件分类，我们通过集成三轴加速度计、八足压力传感器与储层计算（RC）构建了人工本体感知系统。即使四足机器人行走时的动态运动导致传感器输出出现大幅波动，该系统仍能高精度区分平坦与崎岖两种地面条件。我们验证了机器人根据地面条件实时切换行走步态的能力，并进一步讨论了各传感器对地面条件分类的贡献。

title: AppDeltaWorld: Transition-Grounded Delta Code World Model for Mobile GUI Agents
summary: Mobile GUI agents can operate apps through pixel perception and touch actions, making them a promising interface for collecting and improving long-horizon mobile interaction policies. However, real trajectories are difficult to obtain for sensitive apps and privacy-critical operations. At the same time, existing simulated environments are costly to scale up, and GUI world models still suffer from unstable generation, limited modality coverage, and inconsistent action-transition logic. To address these limitations, we propose AppDeltaWorld, a transition-grounded delta code world model that predicts the next GUI as a reachable code update rather than as an unconstrained image or text description. AppDeltaWorld retrieves app-specific Level-1 HTML references under an action-transition constraint, generates Level-2 executable HTML conditioned on the current screen, action, predicted next-screen text, and retrieved structure, and inserts generated visual assets into image slots before browser rendering. As a world model, AppDeltaWorld achieves the highest fidelity on CMGUIBench-500 under Code2World evaluation, with clear gains in structural layout and UI element reconstruction over image-only and code-only baselines. As a training environment, AppDeltaWorld supports filtered closed-loop SFT data construction that, when combined with public supervision, enables AppDeltaAgent to achieve state-of-the-art performance on AndroidLens and consistent gains on MobileGym and MobileWorld. Moreover, world-model-based test-time reinforcement learning enables policy adaptation and shows further improvements without additional interaction with real apps.
tldr: AppDeltaWorld is a transition-grounded delta code world model for mobile GUI agents that predicts the next GUI as a code update, achieving high-fidelity simulation and enabling policy improvement via test-time reinforcement learning.
tldr_zh: AppDeltaWorld是一个基于转换锚定的增量代码世界模型，用于移动GUI代理，通过预测代码更新而非图像来生成高保真模拟，并支持测试时强化学习策略改进。
summary_zh: 移动GUI智能体能够通过像素感知与触控操作来运行应用程序，这使得它们成为收集和改善长期移动交互策略的极具前景的接口。然而，对于敏感应用程序及涉及隐私的关键操作，实际轨迹数据难以获取。与此同时，现有模拟环境扩展成本高昂，且GUI世界模型仍面临生成不稳定、模态覆盖有限以及动作-转换逻辑不一致等问题。为应对这些局限，我们提出AppDeltaWorld——一种基于转换约束的增量代码世界模型，该模型将下一帧GUI预测为可达的代码更新，而非无约束的图像或文本描述。AppDeltaWorld在动作-转换约束下检索应用特定的L1级HTML参考，基于当前屏幕、动作、预测的下一屏幕文本及检索到的结构生成L2级可执行HTML，并在浏览器渲染前将生成的视觉资产插入图像槽位。作为世界模型，AppDeltaWorld在Code2World评估框架下的CMGUIBench-500基准中实现了最高保真度，在结构布局与UI元素重建方面相比纯图像或纯代码基线方法均取得显著提升。作为训练环境，AppDeltaWorld支持经筛选的闭环SFT数据构建，当与公开监督数据结合时，使AppDeltaAgent在AndroidLens上达到最优性能，并在MobileGym与MobileWorld上持续取得提升。此外，基于世界模型的测试时强化学习能够实现策略自适应，并在无需与真实应用额外交互的情况下带来进一步的性能改进。

title: A Unified Framework for Trajectory Prediction with Explicit Planning and Reaction Decomposition
summary: Trajectory prediction has shifted toward structured formulations with explicit social modeling. However, existing methods inadequately distinguish the functional roles of social influence in trajectory planning. Observing that agents typically form motion plans by anticipating others' future behaviors before making local reactive adjustments, we identify social interactions as playing staged roles, namely planning precedes reaction. We propose INTraJ, a unified framework that decomposes social influence into two stages: a planning stage constructs reference trajectories using future social information, and a reaction stage recovers local adjustments from the residual between full-context prediction and the reference. INTraJ supports both multi-target and single-target paradigms. Extensive experiments on four standard benchmarks, including Argoverse 2, Argoverse 2-ped, ETH/UCY, and SDD, demonstrate consistent improvements, particularly in FDE and long-horizon consistency, with state-of-the-art performance achieved in several settings. INTraJ reframes trajectory prediction as a planning-driven two-stage process, validating that staged social modeling is critical for stable predictions. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/11isnotavailable/INTraJ.
tldr: INTraJ is a unified trajectory prediction framework that separates social influence into a planning stage (using future information to construct reference trajectories) and a reaction stage (local adjustments from residuals), achieving SOTA on multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: INTraJ是一个统一的轨迹预测框架，将社会影响分为规划阶段（利用未来信息构建参考轨迹）和反应阶段（从残差中恢复局部调整），在多个基准上达到SOTA。
summary_zh: 轨迹预测已转向具有显式社会建模的结构化公式。然而，现有方法未能充分区分社会影响在轨迹规划中的功能角色。观察到智能体通常先通过预测他人未来行为形成运动规划，再进行局部反应性调整，我们识别出社会互动扮演着阶段性角色，即规划先于反应。我们提出INTraJ这一统一框架，将社会影响分解为两个阶段：规划阶段利用未来社会信息构建参考轨迹，反应阶段从完整上下文预测与参考轨迹的残差中恢复局部调整。INTraJ同时支持多目标与单目标范式。在Argoverse 2、Argoverse 2-ped、ETH/UCY和SDD四个标准基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在FDE（最终位移误差）和长时域一致性指标上实现了一致性改进，并在多个设定中取得最先进性能。INTraJ将轨迹预测重新定义为规划驱动的两阶段过程，验证了阶段性社会建模对于稳定预测的关键作用。代码已公开于https://github.com/11isnotavailable/INTraJ。

title: A Master-Salve Robot Manipulator for Needle-Based Teleoperation in MRI Chamber
summary: We present a MR safe, master-slave robot manipulator for abdominal interventions in the MRI chamber. A human operated 2+1-DoF master controller manipulator transmits motion and force to a 2+1-DoF slave manipulator via fluid transmission. Jointly, a digital master controller provides multimodal control capability beyond common split axis or mode switchable hybrid human-digital controller configurations found in previous studies. High input impedance, low-leakage, elastomeric fluid actuators are delegated to remote angulation control. Low-friction graphite piston cylinders are delegated to needle insertion axis remote actuation given the sub-newton force transparency and sub-millimeter motion transmission over bedside fluid piping lengths. The device enables real-time MRI guided interventions allowing manual, digital, hybrid, and collaborative control modes. Collaborative tasks such as assisted tissue penetration, fault-driven virtual fixture, and motion compensation through feedback control are presented in this paper. Preliminary MR scanner results demonstrate manipulator functional viability for an in-vivo pig experiment in bedside, manual control mode configuration.
tldr: This paper presents a master-slave robot manipulator for MRI-guided needle-based teleoperation, featuring fluid transmission, multimodal control, and collaborative capabilities, demonstrated in an in-vivo pig experiment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于MRI引导的穿刺式遥操作主从机器人操作器，采用流体传输、多模式控制和协作能力，并通过活体猪实验进行了验证。

title: Robot Learning from Human Demonstrations: Handwritten Alphabet Trajectories and Human-Likeness Evaluation
summary: Learning from demonstration (LfD) provides a developmental framework through which robots can develop motor skills by observing and imitating human dynamics, reducing reliance on explicit programming to teach a skill to a robot. The resulting human-like robot motion is recognised as a key factor in building trust and enabling natural collaboration in human-robot interaction. This paper presents a framework for learning human-like robot motion from demonstration, including data collection, probabilistic trajectory learning, and perceptual user evaluation. A dataset of 3,142 handwriting demonstrations was collected from 22 participants across all 52 Latin alphabet character-case combinations via a touchscreen teleoperation interface, capturing planar position, contact force, and timing.
